This script generates the phylogenetic tree from the UFCG output

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/2_Phylogenetic_tree"
#BiocManager::install("ggtree")
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(treeio)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggnewscale)
library(here)
```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Load data
```{r environmental, echo= F}
meta_data = here::here("data")
t= read.newick(file = glue::glue('{meta_data}/tree_data/UFCG_tree.nwk'))
df <- read.csv(glue::glue('{meta_data}/2026_meta_info.csv')) %>% 
  select(-1) 

strain_names = read.csv(file = glue::glue('{meta_data}/study_samples_2026.csv')) %>% 
  select(strain, file_name) %>% distinct()
meta_data <- left_join(df, strain_names) %>% mutate(strain = case_when(is.na(strain) ~ file_name, T ~ strain ))


```

# Set-up parameters
```{r functions}
source(here("src", "theme.R"))
```

# Organize the data
```{r process}
## --- 1. Tree Rooting & Tip Label Cleaning ---
# Root the tree and split the tip labels to extract species and strain info
t1 = root(t, outgroup = c('Aspergillus_homomorphus|none'))

labels = data.frame(label = t1$tip.label) %>% 
  tidyr::separate(label, sep = '\\|', into = c("species", "file_name"), fill = 'left') %>% 
  left_join(strain_names) %>% 
  # Clean up strain names and handle missing values
  mutate(strain = case_when(is.na(strain) ~ file_name, TRUE ~ strain))

# Update the tree object with finalized labels
t1$tip.label <- labels$strain
t1$tip.label <- gsub('Aspergillus', 'A.', t1$tip.label)


## --- 2. Metadata Processing ---
# Select columns and format for compatibility with ggtree/heatmaps
meta <- meta_data[c(2, 4:11)] %>% mutate_at(2:4, as.numeric)

colnames(meta) <- c(
  'Species','Itraconazole', 'Posaconazole', 'Voriconazole', 'Tebuconazole', 
  'Prochloraz', 'Difenoconazole', 'Prothioconazole', 'Origin'
)

# Categorize resistance based on Itraconazole levels
meta <- meta %>% 
  mutate(resistance = case_when(
    Itraconazole > 1  ~ 'NWT',
    Itraconazole < 2  ~ 'WT',
    is.na(Itraconazole) ~ NA, 
    TRUE ~ ''
  ))


## --- 3. Tree Annotation & Visualization ---
# Group the tree by Origin metadata
p = groupOTU(t1, split(meta[1], meta$Origin), group_name = 'Origin') 
p1 = ggtree(t1)

# Identify the Most Recent Common Ancestor (MRCA) for the two main species
shared_node = MRCA(p1, c("A. tubingensis", "A. niger"))
groups = offspring(p1, shared_node, tiponly = FALSE) %>% 
  filter(parent == shared_node)

# Identify specific nodes for Niger and Tubingensis clades
aniger_node = groups$node[which(groups$node %in% ancestor(p, p1$data$node[p1$data$label == 'A. niger']))]
atub_node   = groups$node[which(groups$node %in% ancestor(p, p1$data$node[p1$data$label == 'A. tubingensis']))]

# Final Plot: Assign highlight blocks and labels
tree_df = data.frame(
  node = c(aniger_node, atub_node), 
  lineage = c('A. niger', 'A. tubingensis')
)

p2 = p1 + 
  geom_highlight(data = tree_df, aes(node = node, fill = lineage)) + 
  new_scale_fill() + 
  geom_tiplab(align = FALSE)

```

# View Tree
UFCG Species Tree:
```{r plot_tree, echo =F,fig.width=10, fig.height=15, out.width="100%"}
p2
```

Saving the plots:
```{r}
dir_path = here::here("plots")
ggsave(plot = p2, glue::glue('{dir_path}/S2_tree.svg'), height = 30, width = 20)

```
